## Efecto de los parámetros en la distribución Gamma

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 6
#| warning: false

par(
  mfrow = c(1,2),
  mar = c(5,5,3,1),
  bg = "white",
  family = "sans"
)

# Colores
col1 <- "#1f4e79"
col2 <- "#2e7d32"
col3 <- "#b23a48"

x <- seq(0, 20, length = 600)

# =====================================================
# EFECTO DE α
# =====================================================

plot(
  x, dgamma(x,1,scale=2),
  type = "l",
  lwd = 4,
  col = col1,
  ylim = c(0,0.40),
  xlab = "x",
  ylab = "f(x)",
  main = expression("Efecto de " * alpha * " (" * beta == 2 * ")"),
  cex.main = 1.5,
  cex.lab = 1.3,
  cex.axis = 1.1
)

grid(col = "gray85")

lines(x, dgamma(x,2,scale=2), lwd = 4, col = col2)
lines(x, dgamma(x,5,scale=2), lwd = 4, col = col3)

legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c(expression(alpha==1),
             expression(alpha==2),
             expression(alpha==5)),
  col = c(col1,col2,col3),
  lwd = 4,
  bty = "n",
  cex = 1.1
)

text(
  12, 0.37,
  labels = "Mayor simetría\ncuando α aumenta",
  cex = 1
)

# =====================================================
# EFECTO DE β
# =====================================================

plot(
  x, dgamma(x,3,scale=1),
  type = "l",
  lwd = 4,
  col = col1,
  ylim = c(0,0.40),
  xlab = "x",
  ylab = "f(x)",
  main = expression("Efecto de " * beta * " (" * alpha == 3 * ")"),
  cex.main = 1.5,
  cex.lab = 1.3,
  cex.axis = 1.1
)

grid(col = "gray85")

lines(x, dgamma(x,3,scale=2), lwd = 4, col = col2)
lines(x, dgamma(x,3,scale=3), lwd = 4, col = col3)

legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c(expression(beta==1),
             expression(beta==2),
             expression(beta==3)),
  col = c(col1,col2,col3),
  lwd = 4,
  bty = "n",
  cex = 1.1
)

text(
  13, 0.37,
  labels = "Mayor dispersión\ncuando β aumenta",
  cex = 1
)
```
